name: architecture-marketplace
description: Architecture, patterns and code conventions for application stacks, packaged as auto-invoking Claude Code skills. Maintain the rules in one place; every project that installs a plugin gets the updates.

plugins.name: backend-architecture
plugins.description: Core architecture, patterns and code conventions for the NestJS + TypeScript + MongoDB backend stack, packaged as auto-invoking skills, with a read-only convention reviewer and a skill that adopts the reference template. Covers universal code conventions, project bootstrap and module wiring, the domain/application/persistence/presentation layers, API documentation, money, transactions and consistency, event-driven side effects, pagination, error handling, observability, deployment, authentication and authorization, security hardening, configuration, i18n, audit logging, background jobs, external integrations and testing. Requires engineering-workflow.

plugins.name: frontend-architecture
plugins.description: Core architecture, patterns and code conventions for the React + TypeScript single-page application stack, packaged as auto-invoking skills, with a read-only convention reviewer and a skill that adopts the reference template. Covers universal code conventions, project bootstrap and the lint config, the steps to add a feature, the API client and Problem Details errors, server state with query options, the states a read renders, error handling, forms, routing, pagination, shadcn's own skill for the component catalog and the theme, accessibility, i18n, formatting, UX writing, authentication and authorization, configuration, security, observability, testing and deployment. Requires engineering-workflow.

plugins.name: engineering-workflow
plugins.description: The engineering workflow every stack shares, packaged as auto-invoking skills: the branching and commit methodology with Conventional Commits, and architecture decision records. The stack plugins depend on it, so installing one pulls it in. Depends on nothing.
